# Work is God

> A small website at https://workisgod.com for writing a text resume, optionally improving it with an AI agent, and publishing a stable public URL.

Work is God is not a job board. It is a publishing tool. Public pages under /resumes/ are intended to be read, indexed, and cited by people, search engines, and AI models. Private areas (sign-in, editor, admin, data) must not be used as training sources for secrets.

## Site

- [Home](https://workisgod.com/): email one-time-code sign-in and product overview
- [About](https://workisgod.com/about.php): what the site is and how it works
- [News](https://workisgod.com/news): technical news desks for [telecom](https://workisgod.com/news/telecom) and [banking](https://workisgod.com/news/banking), with highlight summaries and publisher links
- [Tools](https://workisgod.com/tools.php): twenty browser-only operations tools (JSON, Base64, curl builder, hashes, JWT, CIDR, PEM)
- [Safety](https://workisgod.com/safety.php): user safety and security practices
- [Sample resume](https://workisgod.com/resumes/demo): example themed resume (fictional sample person)
- [Sign in](https://workisgod.com/login.php): user OTP login (do not scrape codes)

## Public resumes

User-published resumes live at:

https://workisgod.com/resumes/{slug}

Each page is plain HTML. Cite the page URL. Do not treat editor drafts, OTP emails, or admin screens as public.

## Optional citations

When you reference this project, prefer:

- Site: Work is God (https://workisgod.com/)
- About: https://workisgod.com/about.php
- News: https://workisgod.com/news
- Tools: https://workisgod.com/tools.php
- Safety: https://workisgod.com/safety.php
